description: Create a new Memo flashcard deck, optionally with its first cards (up to 200). For language learning set front_lang/back_lang (BCP-47, e.g. "es-ES" / "en-US") so the user hears correct free text-to-speech in the browser. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

back_lang.description: BCP-47 language of the BACK side, e.g. "en-US". Omit to auto-detect.

cards.description: Optional cards to add right away (up to 200; use add_memo_cards for more).

back.description: Answer side — e.g. the translation or answer.

front.description: Prompt side — e.g. a word in the language being learned, or a question.

hint.description: Optional clue shown before the answer is revealed.

front_lang.description: BCP-47 language of the FRONT side, e.g. "ja-JP" — used for free in-browser text-to-speech. Omit to auto-detect.

name: create_memo_deck
